findings.note: In his most recent game (Nov 18 vs. Hawks) Mitchell scored 13 points with 6 assists in 34 minutes, which is 19 points+assists, under 21.5; CBS says his scoring has dipped, but the Thunder's backcourt injuries should keep giving him chances.

His player page lists season averages of 18.5 points and 3.3 assists, about 21.8 combined and right at the line; he has a recent left ankle sprain that kept him out Nov 14 vs. the Clippers, and he was questionable before returning Nov 16.
On Nov 6 he scored a season-high 35 points with 5 assists. At that point he averaged 19.7 points and 3.7 assists, about 23.4 combined, in a bigger role with Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace out.
